The Story Behind The Brand

This is where my rebirth began.

I didn't create The Rebirth Movement from a textbook. I created it from the most difficult chapter of my own life — and from the decision to rebuild.

I was admitted to hospital with acute pulmonary edema. The left side of my heart had failed, and I was told that the damage was irreversible. I went through an experience where my heart had to be stopped and restarted.

My ejection fraction was measured at 33%. I made a decision to take ownership of my life: coming off medication, locking in spiritually, transforming my diet and health, changing the way I moved and lived, and using peptides as part of my personal approach.

Over my journey, my ejection fraction rose to 60.9%. That number became a symbol of why I called this movement Rebirth.

Rebirth means leaving one life behind and beginning another. It is about discipline, belief, lifestyle, spirituality, health and taking responsibility for the person you are becoming.

I share the knowledge, experience and practices that became part of my own transformation — bringing together nutrition, movement, spirituality, recovery, mindset and the body's natural capacity to adapt and rebuild. My story is the foundation of The Rebirth Movement: a lived example of what can become possible when you completely commit to your health, your mind, your spirit and your lifestyle.

“Reset your body.
Rebuild your mind.
Rise stronger.”

The Rebirth Movement was born from a personal rebirth — physically, mentally, spiritually and through lifestyle.

The Rebirth Philosophy

Your body was built to adapt, repair and renew.

The body is not static. Every day it responds to the food you give it, the movement you give it, the quality of your recovery, your environment, your mindset and the way you live.

The Rebirth Movement is about creating the conditions for your body and mind to perform at their best — through consistent nutrition, purposeful movement, fasting, nature, deep recovery, spiritual connection and disciplined action.

Heal the habits. Rebuild the foundations. Regenerate the lifestyle. Become a new you.

“Your body is designed to heal.
Your mind is designed to grow.
Your life can be reborn.”

90 days of focused action. A new foundation for the life ahead.

The Rebirth Framework

Six pillars. One 90-day commitment.

A practical lifestyle system — not a quick fix.

01

Whole-Food Nutrition

Prioritise minimally processed foods, quality protein, fruit, vegetables, healthy fats and nutrient-dense meals. Build a way of eating you can actually sustain.

02

Fasting & Meal Discipline

Use structured meal timing and, where appropriate, fasting as tools for consistency and appetite awareness — adapted to the individual rather than forced.

03

Movement

Walking, resistance training and daily activity. The goal is to make movement part of your identity, not something you do occasionally.

04

Nature & Recovery

Get outside. Walk. Breathe. Get daylight. Protect sleep and create recovery rituals that bring your nervous system down a gear.

05

Mindset & Spirituality

Reconnect with purpose, gratitude, discipline and whatever spiritual practice gives your life meaning — without prescribing a religion.

06

Accountability

Track the behaviours that matter. Review your progress. Remove excuses. Build momentum through small decisions repeated for 90 days.

90 Days Locked In

Three phases. One transformation.

DAYS 1–30

Reset

Remove obvious friction. Establish food, movement, sleep and daily outdoor routines.

DAYS 31–60

Rebuild

Progress training, refine nutrition, strengthen consistency and build a routine that feels normal.

DAYS 61–90

Regenerate

Turn the routine into identity. Review your data, your habits and the person you have become.

DAY 90+

Rebirth

The programme ends. The lifestyle doesn't. Take what works and keep building.

Measure What Matters

Blood work. Data. Context.

Your health journey should not be based on feelings alone.

Review relevant blood-work results you already have available.
Explain common markers in plain English and help you prepare questions for your clinician.
Track lifestyle metrics such as body weight, waist, steps, sleep and training consistency.
Use progress reviews to identify habits that are working — and habits that need changing.

Blood work gives us a window into what is happening inside the body. We use relevant results as part of the Rebirth process to understand progress, identify opportunities and make more informed lifestyle decisions.

What You Will Work On

Your environment becomes part of the programme.

Food environment

Build a kitchen and shopping routine that makes the better choice the easier choice.

Daily movement

Walk more, sit less and progressively build strength according to your starting point.

Outdoor time

Reconnect with daylight, fresh air and regular time in nature.

Recovery

Protect sleep, manage stress and create a repeatable evening routine.

Mind & spirit

Journaling, reflection, gratitude, prayer or quiet time — your practice, your beliefs.

Identity

Stop waiting for motivation. Build evidence that you are someone who keeps promises to yourself.
